sentences.text: No: for this UCB, penal charges must be treated as penal charges and must not be levied as penal interest added to the rate of interest charged on the advances.
No: the directions say there must be no capitalization of penal charges, meaning no further interest is to be computed on such charges.
The directions also say additional or fresh penal charges must not be levied on the earlier outstanding amount of penal charges.
The older 2023 circular was withdrawn and is no longer in force on the as-of date, so the in-force rule is the 2025 UCB directions.
